european_put_counterexample.purpose: Supports possibility, not universality, of negative price-minus-immediate-intrinsic value; numerical calculation is editorial evidence, not a new student exam exercise.
european_put_counterexample.source: S2 PDF101–102, European parity and pricing; immediate intrinsic S2 PDF97; own numerical deduction.
